clusters.headline: Zambia vote counting resumes after pause over alleged attacks on polling staff
clusters.summary: The electoral commission said violence had "resulted in the theft of marked ballot papers".

clusters.headline: South Korea president proposes talks with North to formally end Korean War
clusters.summary: "Let us put down our intentions to threaten each other and begin discussions to end the long-running war as the directly involved parties," South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Saturday (Aug 15).

clusters.headline: Singapore takes trade compliance seriously, will take firm action against businesses that break laws: MTI
clusters.summary: The United States flagged Singapore among more than 40 countries at risk of being used to circumvent tariffs on Chinese goods.

clusters.headline: NEA rebuts accusations of misappropriation, corruption over Beverage Container Return Scheme refunds
clusters.summary: Consumers have used the machines more than one million times to return a total of 5.5 million containers, meaning each transaction involved an average of about 5.5 containers, said NEA.

clusters.headline: Exclusive-Anthropic IPO valuation hinges on $190-200 billion 2028 revenue forecast, sources say
New aircraft carrier heads toward Mideast after reports of issues on long-deployed USS Lincoln
clusters.summary: The Pacific-based aircraft carrier USS George Washington has begun heading toward the Middle East as reports have emerged of mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln.

clusters.headline: Vultures are disappearing in Nigeria - but the 'Vulture King' is fighting to reverse the trend
clusters.summary: Some see them as sinister or hunt them for ritual use but these birds play a vital role in nature's cycle.

clusters.headline: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
clusters.summary: Women across the country speak of public floggings, losing their jobs, and barriers to healthcare that endanger lives.

clusters.headline: Sen. Ruben Gallego on handling of USS Lincoln conditions: 'That's not proper leadership'
clusters.summary: Lawmakers want answers from the Pentagon chief and the U.S. Navy about living conditions aboard the USS Lincoln. NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Democratic Sen. Ruben Gallego of Arizona.

clusters.headline: Nigeria: U.S. Flags Civilian Deaths, Funding Gaps As Nigeria Pushes for CPC Delisting
clusters.summary: [Vanguard] Despite Nigeria's reported prosecution of hundreds of terror suspects and recruitment of 50,000 police officers, the United States said continuing challenges remained in the fight to remove Nigeria from its Country of Particular Concern, CPC, list.

clusters.headline: Feds probe 'mention markets.' And, lawmakers call for investigation into USS Lincoln
clusters.summary: Federal regulators are reviewing 'mention markets' that allow wagers on what public figures will say. And, Democratic lawmakers call for an investigation into conditions on the long-deployed USS Lincoln.
